patch_description: Replace the greedy-restart-heavy approach with a Local Search / Large Neighborhood Search pipeline: (1) build a small pool of initial solutions via randomized greedy construction, (2) run a ruin-and-recreate LNS loop that removes a random 5-15% of transactions and greedily reinserts each at its best position (evaluated by real makespan), which jumps out of local optima far better than single-element moves, (3) polish with a low-temperature simulated annealing over insertion and adjacent-swap moves. All candidate evaluations use the true makespan (get_opt_seq_cost), and the whole pipeline runs within a fixed time budget, restarting LNS from the incumbent whenever improvement stalls. Ruin-and-recreate perturbs many transactions at once while preserving good global structure, so it explores much more effectively than the previous greedy restarts, which discarded all structure each trial.
